# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 with faster color paths** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the Skia engine to milestone 151 and ports several hot color-conversion paths to managed C#. Alongside the engine bump, SKColor/SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply, and hex-color parsing now run in managed code for lower overhead, and a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData is fixed.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone 151** — Bundles the Skia m151 engine and rolls up several batches of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#3788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3788))

## API Surface

- **Faster color and text parsing** — Ports SKColor/SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, SKColor hex parsing, HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8, HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and SKShaper glyph reads to allocation-light managed implementations, and adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for SKColor parsing. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **GRContextOptions no longer requires unsafe** — Removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions, simplifying consumer code that touches it. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **CPU raster regression fixed** — Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster rendering regression. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))
- **Native resource leak fixed** — Fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI). ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Makes HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) and Tag.Parse allocation-free, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.
